description: Validate one document against the S1000D XML schema (XSD) named by its xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation. The XSD is taken from the xml_schema_flat/ folder found under S1000D_SPEC_DIR (the issue is read from brex.xsd there). Errors are libxml2 messages with line/column. Returns schema-not-found with a reason when no suitable XSD is available.

issue.description: S1000D issue of the XSD to use when several xml_schema_flat/ folders exist (e.g. "7", "4.2"). Default: inferred from the schemaLocation URL.

path.description: File path of the data module (or PM) to check.

xml.description: The document as an XML string (alternative to path; max 5 MB).

name: validate_schema
